title: Llama wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 40,30 60,30' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 45,19 55,19' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='4' fill='#7ae0ff'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='24' r='2' fill='#7ae0ff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='24' r='2' fill='#7ae0ff'/>
  <rect x='40' y='29' width='20' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='44' y='32' width='12' height='34' rx='6' fill='#f4e3c1'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='38' rx='5' ry='9' fill='#e8cfa8'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='38' rx='5' ry='9' fill='#e8cfa8'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#f7e9cc'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#f2d9b0'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#3b2b4a'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#3b2b4a'/>
  <!-- Nose and mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#d98f8f'/>
  <path d='M47 54 Q50 57 53 54' stroke='#c07a6a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='22' ry='17' fill='#f7e9cc'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='36' y='90' width='8' height='9' rx='3' fill='#e8cfa8'/>
  <rect x='56' y='90' width='8' height='9' rx='3' fill='#e8cfa8'/>
  <!-- Fluffy chest -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#fff8ec'/>
</svg>
